caption: Per-language loss in harmful-vs-benign AUROC when gating with CAST's cosine-tanh score instead of the plain projection (English-fit direction, held-out test activations), against the share of benign prompts whose projection is negative. Prop. 1 predicts that CAST scores |projection|, so loss should grow with that share. n = 10 languages; correlation is descriptive (Pearson r = 0.89).
alt_text: Scatter of ten languages: x is the share of benign prompts with negative projection (0.06 to 0.63), y is CAST's AUROC loss. Points rise from Chinese (lowest share, slightly negative loss) to Swahili (high share, about 0.23 loss).
